author: ImRaging
body:
Im pretty sure this has already been reported because of the video uploaded but please review this again because i dont see how this is at all legitimate.

This video is of Lunacy allegedly 'lagging' is, in my opinion, not legit at all. I have received multiple opinions from both sides of the argument and people's reasoning so i think my reasoning is pretty solid.

So in the part of the video where it looks like lunacy is flying, people are claiming he was receiving delayed hits. 

With someone that receives delayed hits, they do sometimes appear to be flying in the air. However, the difference between this example and the video of lunacy is that the player 'flies' in the pattern that they were hit. Still dont understand? Ok. Say that i took delayed kb of 3 seconds, i am hit to the left twice and the right once. This means that my flight pattern will be: left, left, right. I have watched the video of Lunacy multiple times in the slowest speed, and his flight pattern is not how it should be.


Time stamps:

0:13-0:15 Lunacy is approached by murph and is hit twice. Lunacy takes knockback vertically and forwards (in the direction murph hit hit him. This is how delayed kb should be taken).

0:15-0:17 Lunacy is hit once more and flies up drastically. Although this looks sketchy, with delayed knockback+avicus knockback this could be possible and can occur infrequently.

0:17 onwards Lunacy flies up to the left, then up again slightly to the right and up once more before landing onto the monument. Notice how he is looking towards the monument whilst he is flying about in the air? Isn't this a little alarming?

Going back to delayed kb: not only should the hit/fly pattern be the same but the amount of times he changes direction (whether that be up, left or right) should also correlate to the amount of times he was hit. 

Lunacy is hit a total of 3 times. He takes so called 'delayed kb' and/or direction changes 4 times. He shouldn't have taken kb 4 times if he was hit 3. Please if you can explain this do.


If this report is denied i'd like a detailed reason as to why he isn't hacking.

Thank you for taking the time to read through this, Raging.

replies.author: ALM
replies.body:
As I was in support while this happened, I'll take a stab at answering your question.

It was determined that by close examination of the video, you can actually see him turning red while he is in the air right before he changes directions/height. With this fact, we had enough evidence to determine that he was indeed taking kickback while in the air since there is n way to force damage upon yourself and do it so elegantly that it happens directly before an instance of knock back.
